Since a great many codecs are available, the INVITE can grow very long and exceed the maximum size the SIP server accepts. Removing codecs can shorten it.

Removes codecs from the INVITE sent by the plugin's SIP client. Since a great many codecs are available, the INVITE can grow very long and exceed the maximum size the SIP server accepts. Removing codecs can shorten it. Enter the codecs separated by a comma, with no spaces.
plugins/gds3710/desktop/php/gds3710.php.Publie un message dans le centre de mess: Posts a message to Jeedom's message centre, with the time and a link to the snapshot, when the door station rang and nobody answered from Jeedom. Since the door station emits no end-of-call event, an answer on another handset cannot be detected.
plugins/gds3710/desktop/php/gds3710.php.Regex des lignes à supprimer: Regex of the lines to remove
plugins/gds3710/desktop/php/gds3710.php.Si votre portier est en mode webrelay, i: If your door station runs in webrelay mode it has a single relay URL, so both doors trigger the same action. Bind a Jeedom command here to the « Open door 2 » button to give it an effect of its own — fully opening a gate, for instance. Leave empty to query the door station normally.

plugins/gds3710/plugin_info/configuratio.IMPORTANT : Veuillez lire la documentat: IMPORTANT: please read the documentation to learn more
plugins/gds3710/plugin_info/configuratio.Autoriser les utilisateurs limités à eff: Allow restricted users to delete snapshots:
plugins/gds3710/plugin_info/configuratio.Il s'agit de l'identifiant que votre por: This is the username your door station must present in order to publish its events to Jeedom.
plugins/gds3710/plugin_info/configuratio.Il s'agit du mot de passe que votre port: This is the password your door station must present in order to publish its events to Jeedom.
plugins/gds3710/plugin_info/configuratio.Il s'agit du répertoire dans lequel sero: This is the directory where the snapshots are stored.
plugins/gds3710/plugin_info/configuratio.Les captures plus anciennes sont supprim: Older snapshots are deleted every night. Leave at 0 to never purge, which is the plugin's historical behaviour: the directory then grows indefinitely.
plugins/gds3710/plugin_info/configuratio.Par défaut, un évènement n'est accepté q: By default an event is accepted only if it comes from the IP address configured for the door station. Untick only if your Jeedom sits behind a NAT or a proxy that hides the door station's real address.
plugins/gds3710/plugin_info/configuratio.Relève toutes les 15 minutes les entrées: Reads the digital inputs and outputs, the relay states, both temperatures, the uptime and the firmware version every 15 minutes. WARNING: the door station allows a single administrator session, so every read disconnects any session open on its web interface. Untick while configuring the device.
